about.title: Offensive security with defensive vision
about.heading:
Find flaws.
Reduce risks.
Fortify systems.
about.p1: Specializing in offensive security assessments, vulnerability analysis, and tech environment reviews. My work combines technical reconnaissance, manual validation, impact analysis, and practical remediation guidelines.
about.p2: The methodology leverages industry-standard frameworks, including OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, and CVSS, turning complex technical findings into clear security priorities for engineering teams and management.

nightfall.title: Operation Nightfall
nightfall.desc: Demonstrative assessment of a fictitious corporate application with access control vulnerabilities.

modal.p1: Demonstrative assessment of a fictitious corporate application.
modal.p2: During the assessment, key issues were identified regarding access control, data exposure, and input sanitization.
modal.rec: Implementation of strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), centralized input validation, and authorization architecture overhaul.

ironcloud.title: Project Iron Cloud
ironcloud.desc: Demonstrative assessment of fictitious cloud infrastructure evaluating permissions and resource exposure.

modal.p1: Demonstrative assessment of a fictitious cloud infrastructure.
modal.p2: Objective: evaluate identity management, permissions, resource exposure, storage, and network boundaries in a distributed ecosystem.
results: Public S3 buckets containing sensitive backups (Critical)
modal.rec: Enforce Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) on IAM roles, isolate workloads into distinct VPCs, and block public S3 access.

blackbox.title: Operation Blackbox
blackbox.desc: Controlled adversary simulation assessing team prevention, detection, and response capabilities.

modal.p1: Controlled adversary simulation against a fictitious enterprise.
modal.p2: Designed to evaluate security team detection and response capabilities using real-world adversary tactics.
results: Initial entry achieved via Spear Phishing (High)
modal.rec: Enhance EDR detection coverage, harden Active Directory domain policies, and deliver intensive anti-phishing drills.

apisentinel.title: API Sentinel
apisentinel.desc: Demonstrative assessment of a corporate B2B API focusing on authentication and data exposure.

modal.p1: Demonstrative assessment of a fictitious corporate B2B API.
modal.p2: Focused on identifying broken authentication, authorization gaps, data exposure, and lack of rate limiting.
results: Missing rate limiting on authentication routes (High)
Stack trace exposure in error responses (Low)
modal.rec: Enforce object-level authorization (IDOR) checks across sensitive endpoints, deploy API Gateway rate-limiting, and mask stack traces.
